reviews_5s: Works well, but many brick layers have told me this isn't strong enough to be structural. Most of the areas I fixed were because of water infiltration so I'm fine with it not being able to hold up the house :) It works well for filling in the gaps around the outside faucet and dries just like typical mortar AFTER a while. If you put it on deep or thick, it can take more than a week to fully cure. Wish it also came with another nozzle in case you want to use it to fill smaller holes. If the cracks aren't as wide as a brick mortar joint, you have to squeeze it on and push it in. I used gloves and just mushed it in. Then have a spray bottle after a bit and spray off the extra that's on the brick.Did its job on our back concrete patio. So far so good but haven't gone through a winter yet. Will report back!It took me a few tubes to get the pressure right to get it to spread evenly, but once I did that it worked great. Hardens very nice. I am painting over this area so I wasn't too concerned about the mess, but if I was just going to leave it I would have had quite a bit of clean up to do.I used some other brand first. Basically spluged my brick house with a light grey caulk that looks terrible!!! Purchased this and was so much better... not exactly a perfect match, but not noticeable. The applicator tip is also much better. A regular tube of caulk doesn't hold up while being dragged across the brick. Also due to texture, you should overly puncture to open it... heard some complain it doesn't squirt, this is key.Used this product to repair mortar gaps in my steps and was very happy with results, color match was good and application of product was easy. Coverage was good . My recommendation is simple, I would reorder in a heartbeat..I repainted a second garage and sealed the lower trim of the building. Easy to apply and no shrinking or gaps are visible.Bought this product from Lowes for 1.94. Used it to patch holes in a 100 year old chimney. Worked great but I ran out so I thought I would buy more from Amazon. Amazon sold 4 for 19.00. More than Lowes but I didn’t have to go to the store during quarantine. When I got my order from Amazon, it was only 1 tube, not 4. I sent it back.Perfect for the concrete repair!Put on before it got cold but it never dried. Two months later the really thick Areas I filled in are still mushy. I figured the dry Winter air would have caused it to set up in a week but nope. Guess I will wait til Summer and buy some real concrete mixvery happy
reviews_1s:
I have used this product before with no problems. However I just received 6 tubes, used 3 on brick steps and it is not hardening after one week ago application. I have a mess because product still very soft not drying and not adhering to brick. I have 3 tubes left and on Amazon web site states that I can no longer return product that I received about 32 days ago. I don’t understand why Amazon won’t consider partial reimbursement for something that is improperly working? I wanted to apply immediately upon receiving product but due to extreme heat I waited until early September, no rain and temperature ranges from 58-82 degrees, which is ideal for hardening.
Thus far no reply from Amazon and no reply from manufacturer. I am in process of removing product and trying something else.
I would greatly appreciate any help and responseIt’s a pack of five and I only got one single tube!!!Shipped old product -wouldnt flow out tube -- couldn't get out of tube -2 contractors worked for over an hour using 3 separate tubes none would work USELESS PRODUCT. Very hard to pierce the nozzle then when extra strength was applied it squirted out the bottom. I could not find the product in local Home Depot or Lowes - and now know why. I have a 4 story brick building and had used a product similar in the past for small holes in the grout. YOUR PRODUCT WAS IMPOSSIBLE -spent over $100 on useless garbage. and can't even return because by the time I could get a contractor scheduled the return period was 10 days past return date.Applied it for more than 7 days, it just won’t get dry at all. Won’t buy any thing from this store or brand. After that I get one 80LB bag mortar for $9.05 from Lowe’s - just mix with some water, apply that get dry in few hours.I've ordered this product before and it was more consistency of mortor which is what I wanted. I ordered the 2nd and 3rd box and it in the middle changed to more of a white caulk . I do NOT like it! Looks terrible and won't last! It's more of a caulk instead of mortar repair! Don't buy if you need mortar repair.bought a five pack. two tubes had a blue mix to color. had to to try to remove blue mortor and replace. third tube had the same blue mix inthe mortor. package and each tube said gray. defective ptoduct.Takes very long time to dry - been a week and still flexible to touch. I don’t know yet if this will hold bricks in place and I’m very concerned it may not in which case it would be a mess to clean it off the bricks. Also the color is too dark to match existing mortar. Order with caution.It was all dried out when we tried to use it, there was no coating on the inside of where the material is supposed to come outI ordered a set of 5 and 3 had broken tips. The caulk spills without the tips.
